mechanism_narrative: Transit station footfall in Delhi has improved for four consecutive weekly readings (-46.4 to -41.9), and continued transit recovery is the leading indicator of discretionary trip-making; RETAIL_REC therefore rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -46.4 to -41.9 across the four weekly snapshots
failure_condition: The forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the trailing 28-day mean while TRANSIT keeps improving week-over-week.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES is required for retail footfall growth: only when both series improve together do commuter corridors carry enough repeat trips to feed retail-and-recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT (-46.4 to -41.9) and WORKPLACES (-38.6 to -36.4) improved over the four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean is lower than its trailing 28-day mean in weeks when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve together.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has drifted down from +13.3 to +12.0 as households release time-at-home; once the weekly residential index prints below +12.0, substitution toward out-of-home activity accelerates and RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below +12.0, a new four-week low
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL moved +13.3, +11.7, +11.7, +12.0 over the four snapshots
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL prints below +12.0 and the forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is still not higher than the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS is the fastest-recovering category (-72.3 to -65.4), reflecting the post-monsoon outdoor season in Delhi; rising outdoor footfall spills into adjacent retail-and-recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 6.9 points from -72.3 to -65.4 over the four snapshots
failure_condition: PARKS keeps rising on the next weekly prints but the forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Grocery-and-pharmacy trips have saturated near -18, showing essential-trip demand is fully met under Delhi's unlock rules; the marginal trip reallocates to discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC rises within one week of grocery demand flattening.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above -20 for two consecutive weekly prints
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM held in a narrow band -19.1 to -17.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays above -20 for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC's forward one-week mean fails to exceed its trailing one-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing above -60 signals public-space crowding in Delhi; dense crowding triggers re-imposition of local containment rules, which cuts discretionary outings and pushes RETAIL_REC below its trailing four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has climbed 6.9 points and now sits at -65.4, within 5.4 points of -60
failure_condition: PARKS prints above -60 and RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean is equal to or higher than its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Households have held RESIDENTIAL above +11.5 for four straight weeks while GROCERY_PHARM stagnates near -18; that combination means trips are still consolidated into essential channels, cannibalising discretionary retail and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed in the 11.7-13.3 band and GROCERY_PHARM in the -19.1 to -17.1 band across all four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above +11.5 with GROCERY_PHARM near -18 yet RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean exceeds its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Festive-season build-up in Delhi lifts grocery-and-pharmacy basket sizes first; a week-over-week GROCERY_PHARM gain of at least 1.5 points marks the start of festive stock-up that spreads into retail-and-recreation over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM posts a week-over-week rise of at least 1.5 points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM bounced +1.2 points from -19.1 at t-3w to -17.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM gains at least 1.5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean is not higher than its trailing 28-day mean.
